text:
Subject: Broken heater in Apartment 4B, repair needed within 48 hours

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in apartment 4B stopped working on October 2 and is still broken. I called you on October 3 to report it and have not heard back.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s, and the apartment is cold. Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat.

I am asking that the repair be completed within 48 hours of this email. Please reply to confirm when someone can come, and let me know what access you need from me.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
